title: Comint input depends on point relative to process mark

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: `comint-send-input' sends text from the process mark to point when point is after the mark, but retrieves old input when point is before the process mark.
hypothesis: Sending from old history should submit `comint-get-old-input' and copy it to the process mark; sending from the live input area should submit the text after the process mark.
minimal_fixture: Two temporary Comint buffers backed by a shell process that echoes submitted lines with a `got:' prefix.
predicted_behavior: The same visible buffer text can produce different submissions depending on point relative to `process-mark'.
observed_behavior: old-point-output=(#("got:old-cmd" 0 11 (insert-in-front-hooks (comint--mark-as-output comint--mark-yanked-as-output) inhibit-line-move-field-capture t front-sticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture) rear-nonsticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture read-only font-lock-face insert-in-front-hooks) field output))) live-input-output=(#("got:bottom-cmd" 0 14 (insert-in-front-hooks (comint--mark-as-output comint--mark-yanked-as-output) inhibit-line-move-field-capture t front-sticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture) rear-nonsticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture read-only font-lock-face insert-in-front-hooks) field output)))

independent_checks.name: old history submission used comint-get-old-input
independent_checks.detail: (#("got:old-cmd" 0 11 (insert-in-front-hooks (comint--mark-as-output comint--mark-yanked-as-output) inhibit-line-move-field-capture t front-sticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture) rear-nonsticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture read-only font-lock-face insert-in-front-hooks) field output)))

independent_checks.name: live input submission used text after process mark
independent_checks.detail: (#("got:bottom-cmd" 0 14 (insert-in-front-hooks (comint--mark-as-output comint--mark-yanked-as-output) inhibit-line-move-field-capture t front-sticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture) rear-nonsticky (field inhibit-line-move-field-capture read-only font-lock-face insert-in-front-hooks) field output)))

counterexample: A bridge that appends text and sends a newline can submit the wrong command when point is in scrollback or history.
derived_gym_requirement: Comint actions must observe point, process mark, live input text, old-input policy, process identity, and working directory before submitting.
